title: Project 1: From laptop to cluster
summary: Build shipit-api (Node 22 + TypeScript, Postgres, Redis) into a multi-arch image, provision a kind cluster with Gateway API using Terraform, ship it with your own Helm chart, and recreate the whole stack from zero with one command.
objectives: Write a production-shaped Node.js service with liveness/readiness endpoints and graceful shutdown
Build and publish a multi-arch (arm64 + amd64) image with buildx and verify its manifest list
Provision a kind cluster, Gateway API CRDs, a Gateway implementation and namespaces with Terraform
Author two Helm charts (app and data) and deploy them with Terraform helm_release or Argo CD
Prove zero-downtime rollouts and explain every design decision and trade-off in an interview
Tear down and recreate the entire environment from zero with a single Makefile target
